verdicts.evidence: The `CIBUILDWHEEL` environment comparison is part of an install-time gate: when it equals `1` and `supports_speedups` is true, it selects `run_setup(True)` (s1; f1:60-61).

The `CIBUILDWHEEL` check determines whether setup immediately runs with the binary extension; otherwise, supported interpreters try the binary build and may fall back to a plain-Python build, while unsupported interpreters use the plain-Python build (s2; f1:60-81).
